project.name: AI Context Keeper
project.description: VS Code extension that persists AI conversation context across sessions. Injects project knowledge into Copilot chats so the AI remembers what you were working on.

architecture.overview: Single extension with chat participant (@context) that loads/saves context from JSON files

keyPaths.src/extension.ts: Main entry point - activates extension, registers commands and chat participant
keyPaths.src/contextManager.ts: Core logic - load/save context, token budgeting, format context for injection
keyPaths.src/autoAnalyzer.ts: Detects project stack from package.json, requirements.txt, etc.

conventions.naming: camelCase for functions/variables, PascalCase for types

decisions.decision: Use two context files instead of one
decisions.reason: ai-context.json is committed for team sharing, ai-context.local.json is gitignored for personal notes
Balances context richness with leaving room for actual conversation
